title: AI Agents & Agentic Systems
description: Techlio builds AI agents and RAG knowledge systems grounded in your data, with citations, guardrails, evals and full audit trails.
h1: AI agents that reach production, *and stay there.*
intro: Most agent pilots stall on the same things: messy data, legacy integrations and no way to prove the agent is right. We build agents, copilots and knowledge systems with those solved first, so they ship, act through permissioned tools and hand off to a person when the evidence is thin.
caption: A question passes an access check, searches company sources, is composed and cited, then checked for grounding before it is delivered or handed off.
offerIntro: Four stages, in order. The eval set from stage one is what every later change is measured against.

offerings.title: Map the knowledge
offerings.text: We inventory your sources, their owners and their permissions, and collect real questions with known good answers as the first eval set.

offerings.title: Design the system
offerings.text: Retrieval strategy, model selection, tools the agent may call, and the guardrails and thresholds around each action.

offerings.title: Build and evaluate
offerings.text: The agent is built against the eval set. Retrieval quality, answer grounding and tool use are each scored separately.

offerings.title: Deploy with guardrails
offerings.text: Rollout to a small group first, with human review on low-confidence answers and a trace stored for every decision.

whyTitle: Why these agents survive contact with real users

why.title: Evals over guesswork
why.text: Every prompt, model or retrieval change is scored on your own cases before release. A regression fails the build.

why.title: Guardrails by default
why.text: Permission checks, injection screening and human review on high-impact actions ship with the first version.

why.title: Answers that act
why.text: Agents work through typed, permissioned tools, so they can update a record or open a ticket without free rein over your systems.

closeTitle: What should your team be able to ask, and have done?
closeText: Bring the questions and tasks you have in mind. We will show you what a grounded, auditable agent for them would involve.

card.lead: Agents that act, with answers you can audit.
card.text: Agents, copilots and knowledge systems grounded in your data, with evals, guardrails and a full trace behind every action.

faqs.question: What is the difference between an AI agent and a chatbot?
faqs.answer: A chatbot answers questions. An agent also acts: it can look up an order, update a CRM record, create a ticket or draft a document, using tools it has been given permission to use.

faqs.question: How do you stop an agent giving wrong answers?
faqs.answer: We build an evaluation set from your real cases and score every change against it. In production, answers are checked against the retrieved sources, and low-confidence cases go to a person.

faqs.question: Which AI models do you build with?
faqs.answer: We choose per project and test candidates against your eval set. We commonly work with Claude and OpenAI models and can use open models where data must stay in your environment.

faqs.question: Can the agent work with our existing systems?
faqs.answer: Yes. Agents connect to CRMs, help desks, databases, document stores and internal APIs through permissioned tools, using the same access rules a staff member would have.

faqs.question: How long does it take to build an AI agent?
faqs.answer: It depends on how many systems it touches and how clean the data is. A focused first agent is usually measured in weeks. A scoping call gives you an estimate for your case.

faqs.question: Who owns the code and the data?
faqs.answer: You do. Work happens in your accounts and repositories where possible, and intellectual property transfers to you. A mutual NDA is available before the first call.

metaTitle: AI Agent Development and Agentic AI Systems
answer: An AI agent is software that uses a language model to understand a request, look up the facts it needs in your systems, and take an action such as updating a record or replying to a customer. Techlio designs and builds these agents for companies that need them to work in production: grounded in your own data, tested against real cases, limited to approved actions, and able to hand off to a person when unsure.
